question: Which oxygenated sesquiterpene has the highest percentage in the heavy fraction from molecular distillation of niaouli oil residue, and what was its percentage in the original residue?
rendered:
document title="Green enrichment of α-terpineol from niaouli oil residue via molecular distillation"

=== page 9 ===
- Among these, pure a-terpineol showed the strongest antibacterial activity, particularly against S. aureus (21.85 mm) and K. pneumoniae (20.16 mm).
- Among all samples, pure a-terpineol exhibited the strongest anti-inammatory activity, with an IC50 of 41.84 ± 1.39 mg mL^−1, conrming its role as the principal active component.
- In contrast, the niaouli oil residue (NOR) showed the weakest activity, with an IC50 of 329.16 ± 7.29 mg mL^−1.

- fraction (HF; IC50 = 161.23 ± 3.10 mg mL^−1) and, more notably, the a-terpineol-enriched light fraction (LF), which exhibited a lower IC50 value of 135.01 ± 4.51 mg mL^−1.

=== page 11 ===
- In addition to its anti-inammatory efficacy, the LF also exhibited high biocompatibility, showing the highest cell viability (from 68.58 ± 0.27 to 103.87 ± 0.97) among all fractions and even a tendency to promote cell proliferation at low concentrations 25–100 (mg mL^−1).
- Notably, at the IC50 level, the cell viability of all samples remained above 70% (Table 7), indicating that the observed anti-inammatory effects were achieved without signicant cytotoxicity.

=== page 9 ===
- As shown in Table 4 and Fig. 9, the NOR— obtained aer vacuum fractional distillation for eucalyptol recovery—contained only a relatively low level of eucalyptol (6.93%), indicating that most of this light component had been removed in the upstream process.
- Consistently, light mono-terpenes were largely depleted, with only a trace amount of limonene detected (0.38%).
- In contrast, oxygenated mono-terpenes with higher boiling points remained at appreciable levels, among which a-terpineol accounted for 36.52%, high-lighting the NOR as a promising source for the recovery of biologically valuable compounds.
- Molecular distillation resulted in a marked enrichment of a-terpineol in the light fraction, increasing from 36.52% in the niaouli oil residue to 66.10%.
- The heavy fraction (HF) also retained 19.64% a-terpineol, likely due to the high viscosity of the residue, which hindered efficient evaporation and resulted in partial retention of this relatively volatile compound.

The oxygenated sesquiterpene with the highest percentage in the heavy fraction is guaiol, which was 12.59% in the heavy fraction. Its percentage in the original residue was not specified in the given snippet.
